title: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined
provenance: community test report by alemolamg (highball-db#9), unverified by Highball. geoffbonina (highball-db#1122, 2026-11-09), Apple M5, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.10.26, engine x64-crossover26.3-r31, DXMT, rated 4 of 5 after 2 minutes: a pretty steady frame rate on Wine 11 compared with Wine 10. The reporter closed the report.
notes: Runs and plays well. Reported on an Apple M5 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.8.3, engine wine-10.0 (Sikarugir) r1, Steam, automatic graphics mode (DXMT). Stutter during the first combats eases after a few minutes (shader warm-up); sustained high GPU load, the Mac runs warm and loud; no crash or instability. The executable carries D3D12 references, so D3DMetal is worth trying if a future build regresses under DXMT. On an M5 with the Wine 11 engine r31 and DXMT the frame rate is steadier than on Wine 10 (highball-db#1122).
